\begin{minipage}{\linewidth}\scriptsize\raggedright
\textit{Population:} BASE paired with FINAL[v]; FINAL[v1] vs FINAL[v2] (composite). \textit{Unit:} base cell.
\textit{CI:} 95\% CI: nonparametric cluster bootstrap, percentile intervals, stratified by block (pilot benchmarks resampled among the 12 pilot benchmarks, full\_ext among its 48); seed 20261017; cluster = benchmark; 10,000 replicates for the primary-family estimates (R04 composite with strata endpoint+variant, R05 composite with strata comparison+endpoint; Holm-adjusted tests in T9); p-values: two-sided bootstrap p = min(1, 2 * min(share of replicate differences \textless{}= 0, share \textgreater{}= 0)) with replicates\_primary; Holm step-down at alpha 0.05 over the 12 primary hypotheses.
Composite cohort (pilot + full\_ext); R04 net\_gain (3 variants) and R05 variant\_difference (3 pairs) for the endpoints Q06 and E02 on the composite cohort: 12 hypotheses H0: difference = 0.
Every hypothesis rests on the methodology's primary replicate count (B = 10,000 drawn, checked; resamples skipped for a zero denominator, if any, are counted in the CI note); everything outside this table is descriptive (unadjusted CIs, no tests); the per-block estimates of the same hypotheses are in T9b.
Resolution (B = 10,000 replicates; a p below its resolution is shown as '\textless{}resolution'): p\_resolution = 2/B = 0.0002 (primary family only: the smallest positive two-sided bootstrap p-value, 2 / replicates\_primary; a p\_value of 0 means p \textless{} p\_resolution); p\_holm\_resolution = 0.0024 (primary family only: the Holm-adjusted resolution, the running maximum over the Holm order of (m - rank + 1) * p\_resolution; a p\_holm of 0 means p\_holm \textless{} p\_holm\_resolution).
Denominator exclusions (methodology missingness rules; JSON key excluded): no unit is excluded in this table by R04 (base cell(s) outside the paired cohort); R05 (base cell(s) outside the paired cohort).
BL01: Includes dense\_la/00 (BL-01 tolerance convention: possible false FAIL verdicts; disclosure-bearing aggregate); sensitivity SA1 in T10.
IC1: Q06 is in-sample for test\_feedback and combined\_feedback: their loops see the ParEval test verdict and stop when it passes (every stopped\_tests\_pass trajectory is a Q06 pass), so they optimise the endpoint; for static\_feedback Q06 is out-of-sample (measured once in phase 2, never seen by the loop). The variants therefore differ in trigger and stop rules, not only in feedback content; test\_feedback cannot regress on Q06 by construction.
IC2: E02 is not an independent confirmation of Q06 gains: it counts build failures, and most E02 improvements are the same cells as the Q06 improvements; the held-out signal proper is the joint transition X06 (e.g. Q06 repaired but E02 still failing) and G01.
IC5: The composite primary estimates pool the pilot (12 clusters) and full\_ext (48 clusters) blocks; the per-block estimates (T9b) are descriptive, the pilot ones approximate; a composite difference need not hold in both blocks.
IC6: static\_feedback repair triggers are dominated by clang-tidy bugprone findings and, on MPI, by low-confidence hints (design document: no trustworthy static MPI tool exists); static\_feedback results measure this frozen blocking-set configuration, not static analysis in general.
\textit{Definitions} (methodology; full text in the JSON form of this table): BASE; FINAL; R04 net\_gain; R05 variant\_difference.\par
